_readme: Tax tables are DATA, not code. Dollar amounts are whole dollars per YEAR; rates are percent strings (converted to exact integer ppm). Every block carries `verified` — the payroll service refuses to FINALIZE a payroll run while any block it uses is unverified, unless the company is in calculate-only (beta) mode. Only the Professional Review Board may set verified=true, recording reviewer and source.

federal.source: IRS Pub 15-T (2026), Cat. 32112B dated Dec 3 2025 (copy: https://ers.ehawaii.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/ERS-ver-P15-T-2026.pdf), Worksheet 1A and Annual Percentage Method tables, transcribed by Review Board #1; SSA 2026 wage base $184,500. `brackets`/`standardDeduction` are kept for reference/cross-checks; withholding uses `percentageMethodTables` exactly as printed.

percentageMethodTables._rows: [over (column A), tentative amount (column C), percentage (column D)] — annual; excess measured from 'over'

pre2020W4._note: Worksheet 1A lines 1j-1l: annual wages - allowances x $4,300; STANDARD table; Single or Married only (no Head of Household for 2019-or-earlier forms).

futa._note: Net rate after the full 5.4% state credit. Credit-reduction states (announced by US DOL each November) are a year-end true-up on Form 940, not a per-paycheck amount.

TX.source: Texas has no personal income tax. TWC taxable wage base $9,000; new-employer rate 2.7% (company's assigned rate overrides).

CO.source: CO DOR 2026 DR 1098 (https://tax.colorado.gov/sites/tax/files/documents/DR_1098_Colorado_Withholding_Worksheet_for_Employees.pdf): 4.4% x (annualized wages - DR 0004 allowance, or line 2a default). FAMLI 2026 0.88% split 50/50, capped at SS wage base. CDLE UI wage base $30,600. New-employer UI rate varies by industry (1.7% is a placeholder; company must enter its assigned rate).

incomeTax._allowanceNote: Annual allowance comes from the employee's DR 0004 (line 2). Without a DR 0004, DR 1098 line 2a: $11,000 if the federal W-4 says married filing jointly, otherwise $5,500.

CA.source: CA EDD 2026 Method B (https://edd.ca.gov/siteassets/files/pdf_pub_ctr/26methb.pdf), checked by Review Board #1 against DE 44 Examples A, B, E, F. SDI 2026 1.3%, no wage cap. UI wage base $7,000; ETT 0.1%. Engine annualizes; DE 44 per-period tables can differ by 1-2 cents (open item).

DC.source: DC OTR brackets (TY2022+): 4/6/6.5/8.5/9.25/9.75/10.75%. Withholding per DC Code 47-1812.08(b)(1A) and FR-230: NO standard deduction; subtract $4,150 per D-4 allowance (latest official publication is the 2018 FR-230 — confirm with OTR). Paid Family Leave employer-only 0.75% (secondary sources). DOES UI wage base $9,000 + 0.2% administrative assessment.
